title: ci: drop unused x86 Homebrew install from macOS prebuild
description:
Mirrors posit-dev/ark#1417.

The x64 step in `build-ark-macos.yml` installed an x86 Homebrew into `/usr/local` and put its `bin` first on `PATH` so pkg-config could find an x86 libsodium for zeromq. Neither is used: ark's `zmq-sys` builds libzmq from vendored sources via `zeromq-src` and calls `with_libsodium(None)`, so nothing under `/usr/local` is consulted during the build.

Homebrew 7.0 (released 2026-09-13) made the installer refuse to run under Rosetta on Apple Silicon (`Homebrew on macOS is only supported on Apple Silicon processors!`), which turned this no-op step into a hard failure. This broke the Positron daily's Ark prebuild on 2026-09-21: https://github.com/posit-dev/positron-builds/actions/runs/35573145309/job/106249465641

The identical change in ark was verified by a `workflow_dispatch` run of `release-macos.yml`: all arm64/x64 release/debug builds and both universal binaries passed, and the x64 artifact is a genuine `x86_64` Mach-O (https://github.com/posit-dev/ark/actions/runs/35613337684).

Testing here: `build-ark.yml` dispatched on this branch with `ark_ref` set to the ark SHA the daily currently needs; link in comments. A passing run also publishes the prebuild the daily is missing.

title: Stop building the macOS universal Ark binary
description:
This PR removes the macOS universal (`darwin-universal`) Ark prebuild as part of the cleanup for posit-dev/positron#8423. It is the companion to posit-dev/ark#1434, which removes the same build from the Ark releases.

## Why we can remove it

Positron now installs the Ark build that matches the host architecture (posit-dev/positron#13441). `install-kernel.ts` downloads only the `darwin-arm64` or `darwin-x64` zip from this repo. Nothing in the Positron build uses the universal zip.

Existing releases keep their universal assets. Thus, older Positron branches that use an existing prebuild will see no change.

## Changes

- `build-ark-macos.yml`: Remove the `build_universal` job. Update the header comment so that it lists only the arm64 and x64 archives.
- `build-ark.yml`: Remove the `darwin-universal` zip from the release assets.

After this change, each prebuild release has six zips: arm64 and x64 for each of macOS, Windows, and Linux.

## Testing

Both workflow files parse as valid YAML. The next prebuild run is the real test of this change.
